taxonomy_loading: Load the effective existing domain/file taxonomy with official load_skill_taxonomy, serialize it once per requested runtime, then change only family_candidates/default_family_name.
family_identity: Canonical id/name/aliases come from the selected immutable catalog version; no task-name inference.
family_id_transport: Candidate id is resolved by pipeline.resolve_run_metadata; family_id is not a public extract_from_doc keyword.

default_control.exception: Empty family_id is allowed only in this named legacy control mode.

semantic_conflict_detection: Reviewed source status and explicit rule_conflicts only; this tool does not infer semantic compatibility.
